title: Interactive Map Bundled Data
description: The exact shape of window.RKBY_MAP_DATA as written into map-data.js by scripts/generate_interactive_map.py. Supersedes specs/003-interactive-photo-map/contracts/map-data.schema.json: members[].x/y become members[].lat/lon, and the image (baked pixel canvas + tile pyramid) block is replaced by basemap (the embedded PMTiles archive asset). See specs/004-pmtiles-basemap/data-model.md and research.md §2/§5 for the rationale, and specs/003-interactive-photo-map/data-model.md for the field-minimization rationale unchanged from spec 003 (Constitution Principle I).

seasons.description: Every season discover_seasons() found, sorted ascending (string sort matches chronological order, e.g. "2024-25" < "2025-26"). Includes seasons with zero eligible members.

members.description: One entry per distinct match_key eligible in at least one season. Never includes address, phone, email, birthday, sex, motive_for_participation, food_restrictions, status, excluded, or ignore (Principle I minimization).

name.description: first_name + last_name from the person's latest eligible season-record (FR-010).

num_previous_seasons.description: From the latest eligible season-record; null when not on file (FR-016 renders this as unknown, not blank).

photo.description: Path relative to interactive_map/, e.g. "photos/jane-doe.jpg" or "photos/placeholder.png" -- a square-cropped, fixed-size marker thumbnail. Never null.

photo_full.description: Path relative to interactive_map/, e.g. "photos/jane-doe-full.jpg" or "photos/placeholder.png" -- the member's own full (uncropped) photo shown in the hover popup. Distinct file from `photo`. Never null.

lat.description: The member's own geocoded latitude, passed through unchanged from their merged record (merge.py) -- no pixel projection (data-model.md § Merged Member, research.md §5).

lon.description: The member's own geocoded longitude, same passthrough as lat.

seasons.description: Every season this person has an eligible record in (not only active ones) -- keys are season labels. The frontend filters this live by the active season set; it is not pre-filtered here.

role.description: Raw primary role text for that season-record, e.g. "Rider", "Service Crew", "Supporter", or null if not on file.

additional_roles.description: Empty array when known-empty (mirrors the schema's null-vs-empty-array distinction for the source field).

basemap.description: Describes the base64-embedded PMTiles archive asset (research.md §2) -- deliberately carries no minZoom/maxZoom/bounds: the frontend reads those straight from the embedded archive's own header at runtime (pmtiles.PMTiles#getHeader(), research.md §6) so there is exactly one source of truth for the archive's own coverage.

file.description: Filename of the base64-embedding script relative to interactive_map/, e.g. "basemap-pmtiles.js".

variable.description: Global variable name that basemap.file sets on window, e.g. "RKBY_PMTILES_BASE64" -- read as window[basemap.variable] rather than a name hardcoded independently on both the Python and JS sides.
